summary: Frontend verification of the AvatarWithBadge offline-hiding bug fix + Profile Friends list / User profile hero / Friends Inbox surfaces newly hosting AvatarWithBadge. Logged in as Alex (member@friendplace.com.au) via API-token-in-localStorage seed, then drove the Profile → User profile → Friends Inbox flows against the real preview backend with pre-seeded manual/online/offline statuses for demo users. All 6 status glyphs render on the Profile 'Friends' section (Arthur=⚫ offline-no-doc, Bill=🟡 busy, Dorothy=☕ in_cafe, Eileen=⚫ offline-stale, Frank=🦋 looking, Joyce=😊 happy, Margaret=🟢 online). Café precedence over happy verified (dot: manual=happy + in_cafe_table_id set → shows ☕). User hero avatars (Joycey=😊, Dorothy=☕) render the corner badge on the large 110px hero. Friends Inbox Roy row shows 🦋 (Looking) badge. Alex's own hero on /profile shows NO badge (glyph count in hero region == 0), matching the isSelf design decision. Initial /api/status/for-users call on /profile batched all 7 friend IDs into ONE request (verified via network trace). No React-Native red screen; only pre-existing console warnings (shadow*/textShadow* deprecation, useNativeDriver missing on web).

critical_code_review_comments: user/[id].tsx L129-136 keeps a LEGACY status pill fed by u.status (looking_to_chat/in_coffee_lounge/happy_to_connect/busy/else→⚫). It coexists with the new AvatarWithBadge corner glyph on the hero. Today u.status is empty on all demo users so the pill is hidden and doesn't compete — but consider retiring that pill entirely in a follow-up to avoid two conflicting status surfaces on the same screen (design LOCK: 'the glyph tells the story').

profile.tsx Friends list wraps AvatarWithBadge inside a Pressable at 28px. Badge diameter min-caps to 16 (AvatarWithBadge L123) which is ~57% of the avatar. Cosmetic-only — badge stays legible in the screenshot — but on a 28px avatar the badge is more prominent than the 22-26px range used on 40-60px avatars. Not a functional bug.
seed_data_creation: Alex's friends list populated with [art, billdo, dot, eil, frankie, joycey, maggie] (both sides) and one pending friend-request from roy → alex. member_status collection seeded so effective states cover ALL 6 glyphs at once: maggie=online, frankie=looking, joycey=happy, billdo=busy, dot=in_cafe (with happy manual — proves café beats happy), art=offline (no doc), eil=offline (stale last_seen 15min ago), roy=looking. Seed scripts left in /app/backend/scripts/ for re-use; heartbeats decay after 5min so re-run before subsequent UI verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Because presence heartbeats decay in 5 min, seed data MUST be refreshed right before UI tests: `cd /app/backend && python3 scripts/seed_status_for_test.py && python3 scripts/seed_alex_friends_for_test.py`. Login into the Expo web preview by fetching /api/auth/login inside page.evaluate and writing `yb_token` (raw string) and `yb_user` (JSON.stringify) into localStorage, then reload — AsyncStorage on RN-web maps 1:1 to localStorage. Note the header FriendPlace logo is an image (not text 🦋) so 🦋 count in innerText reflects actual on-page 🦋 glyphs (badges/labels). On /user/{id} there is still a LEGACY status pill (user/[id].tsx L129-136) using u.status — dormant today because demo users have no legacy status field, but be aware it can double-render if that field ever becomes populated. All 6 effective statuses verified rendering on Profile 'Friends' section; hero badges verified on joycey (happy=😊) and dot (in_cafe=☕). Self hero on /profile confirmed badgeless.
rca_of_issue: Verified fix in AvatarWithBadge.tsx: the earlier `!!effective && effective !== 'offline'` gate has been replaced by `shouldShowBadge = showBadge && !isSelf && !!effective` (L119). Combined with the status-context STATUS_META `offline: '⚫'` mapping (L67), every non-null effective status now yields a visible badge. Additive component swaps confirmed: profile.tsx L332 (Friends list), user/[id].tsx L122 (hero), friends/inbox.tsx L68 (pending-request row). Layout untouched (verified visually against prior iteration screenshots — same spacing, same colours, same copy). Batched fetch confirmed: /api/status/for-users on /profile mounted with all 7 friend user_ids in ONE query-string call, then follow-up single-id calls only on subsequent screen mounts (each screen's <AvatarWithBadge> triggers its own coalesced fetch, which is expected). No regression to composer/notification-feed avatars (they pass showBadge={false} — code path unchanged).
